relationships.evidence_quote: PRF was associated with reductions in IRF8, microglial markers (Iba1), and phosphorylated MAPKs (p-p38 and p-ERK)

relationships.subject: pulsed radiofrequency
relationships.evidence_quote: In mixed-target models, PRF reduced circulating IL-1β and TNF-α as well as spinal β-catenin, alongside behavioral improvement.

key_findings: Systematic review of 17 rodent studies: PRF at DRG or peripheral nerve dampens microglial/MAPK signaling and normalizes Nav1.7, TRPV1/CGRP, P2X3.
Only one study showed direct epigenetic effect: PRF reversed CFA-induced H3/H4 hypoacetylation at the Kcc2 locus, restoring KCC2.
